# Pestly

> AI phone assistant for pest control / Schädlingsbekämpfung companies.

## Summary
Pestly answers calls, WhatsApp, SMS, email, and website widgets; books calendar appointments; escalates emergencies with transcript SMS. Built for pest control operators who miss leads while on jobs — not a generic call-center bot.

## Primary audience
- German pest control businesses (solo → multi-van)
- Owners and office managers
- Secondary: English-speaking pest control teams

## Pricing
- No public list prices (depends on channels, locations, complexity)
- Free, non-binding demo
- No minimum contract advertised as a hard requirement in product FAQ
- See /pricing.md for agent-readable pricing stance
- Contact: info@pestly.de

## Differentiators
- Vertical focus: pest control terminology and workflows
- Multichannel intake (voice + messaging)
- Emergency escalation with transcript
- EU/DE-oriented data processing narrative (see privacy page)
- Setup typically about 5 days per site FAQ

## What it is not
- Not a full replacement for on-site inspection or licensed pest treatment
- Not a generic “AI receptionist for any industry” positioning
- Not opaque “contact sales only” without a demo path — free demo is the entry
